item.title: Democrats celebrate upset win in Tarrant County, but Republicans expect payback in November
item.description: Taylor Rehmet, a veteran, machinist and union leader, pulled off an upset win for a Texas state senate seat in a reliably red district over the weekend. State and national Democratic leaders say the victory will give them momentum to do the same in other areas during the November midterms.

item.title: VIDEO: Splendora police use 'Grappler' to stop speeding suspect
item.description: Dramatic footage released by Splendora police shows officers using a grappler tool to safely end a chase with a car that had children inside.

item.title: Artemis II wet dress rehearsal begins, simulating launch day
item.description: NASA is conducting a full practice run of the Artemis II mission, including fueling the Space Launch System rocket and simulating a launch countdown, ahead of the first crewed mission to orbit the Moon in over 50 years.

item.title: One dead, 5 injured in shooting at northeast Houston trail ride
item.description: Gunfire erupts at trail riding event in Northeast Houston, leaving 1 dead and 5 injured. Police search for shooters. Chaos ensues.

item.title: 'Today' show anchor Savannah Guthrie's mother missing in Arizona
item.description: "Today" show host Savannah Guthrie's 84-year-old mother is missing, and authorities are asking for the public's help.

item.title: Man dead, woman hurt in shooting in northwest Houston apartment, HCSO says
item.description: A man was killed and a woman was injured in a shooting at an apartment complex in northwest Houston, investigators said.

item.title: Good-bye arctic air, warmer with a chance of rain this week
item.description: SE Texas will experience a freezing morning with temperatures in the 20s, but will rebound to the 50s with sunshine on Sunday, and the upcoming week will see temperatures flirting with the 70s with a few chances for rain.

item.title: Body of missing man who was fishing found in Buffalo Bayou, HPD says
item.description: The body of a man who police said was fishing last week was found in Buffalo Bayou on Monday afternoon, Houston police said.

item.title: Menefee sworn in for Texas Congressional District 18 Seat
item.description: Christian Menefee wins special election runoff in Texas Congressional District 18, defeating Amanda Edwards with 68% of the vote.

item.title: Student stabbed, injured at Grand Oaks High School in Conroe, district says
item.description: A student is hospitalized after being stabbed at Grand Oaks High School in Conroe, according to officials.
